description: This file declares functions and structures related to the fsmonitor extension within a version control system, likely Git. It handles reading, writing, adding, removing, tweaking, and refreshing the fsmonitor extension in the index, as well as checking responses related to fsmonitor.

methods.name: read_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Reads the fsmonitor index extension and restores its valid state if configured.

methods.name: fill_fsmonitor_bitmap
methods.description: Updates the fsmonitor_dirty ewah bits with their state from the index before it is split during writing.

methods.name: write_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Writes the CE_FSMONITOR_VALID state into the fsmonitor index extension based on the current dirty bits.

methods.name: add_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adds the fsmonitor index extension to the index.

methods.name: remove_fsmonitor
methods.description: Removes the fsmonitor index extension from the index.

methods.name: tweak_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adjusts the fsmonitor extension based on current configuration settings.

methods.name: refresh_fsmonitor
methods.description: Runs the fsmonitor integration script, updates validity bits, and invalidates related cache structures.

methods.name: fsmonitor_is_trivial_response
methods.description: Checks if the received fsmonitor query result is the trivial response.
